connection_fields.name: api_url
connection_fields.description: Slack's API URL, for a proxy

connection_fields.name: connect_timeout
connection_fields.description: how long to wait for a connection (`30s`, `2m`, or seconds)

connection_fields.name: timeout
connection_fields.description: how long a read or write may make no progress before it fails

connection_fields.name: retries
connection_fields.description: how many times to try again after a temporary error (0: never)

connection_fields.name: retry_wait
connection_fields.description: the first wait before trying again (`30s`), doubling each try; a server's Retry-After wins

option_fields.name: user
option_fields.description: a user ID (U0123), for a direct message

option_fields.name: message
option_fields.description: the text posted with the files

option_fields.name: retries
option_fields.description: how many times to try again after a temporary error such as a rate limit (0: never)

option_fields.name: retry_wait
option_fields.description: the first wait before trying again (`30s`), doubling each try; a server's Retry-After wins
